name: specstream
displayName: SpecStream: lead lists and web data for agents
description: Ask Copilot or your agent for a lead list, a company list or open grants. Every match comes from the live web, with its source. Pay per match.

chatParticipants.name: specstream
chatParticipants.description: Ask for the list no one sells. See the price, approve it, get every match with its source.

commands.name: find
commands.description: Describe the list you need. You see the price before anything runs.

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Run the list at the price you were shown.

disambiguation.description: The user wants a list of companies, tenders, grants, repositories, filings or other things found on the live web, with a source for each row.
examples: Companies that filed a Form D this week to raise $5M or more, with state and industry
MCP servers on GitHub with more than 500 stars, pushed this month

commands.title: Use an API Key Instead of Signing In

specstream.maxMatches.markdownDescription: How many matches `@specstream /find` asks for. The price you approve is for at most this many.

specstream.serverUrl.markdownDescription: The SpecStream MCP server address. Leave as is unless support asks you to change it.

walkthroughs.title: Get your first list with SpecStream
walkthroughs.description: Connect, ask for a list in plain words, and open it in the workspace.

steps.title: Connect SpecStream
steps.description:
Sign in once. VS Code keeps you signed in and adds SpecStream to agent mode too.
[Connect](command:specstream.connect)

steps.title: Ask for a list
steps.description:
Describe the list in your own words. You see the price first, and nothing runs until you approve it.
[Ask for a list](command:specstream.askForList)

steps.title: Open it in the workspace
steps.description:
Every match sits in your workspace with the page behind each fact, ready to send to your sheet, CRM or agent.
[Open workspace](command:specstream.openList)
